core_problem_solved: To provide the core implementation of the Apache Log4j 2 logging framework, containing the logic for processing log events and routing them to various destinations (appenders).
key_features: A high-performance, asynchronous logging engine to prevent blocking application threads
A rich set of appenders (Console, File, RollingFile, Socket, etc.)
Flexible layouts for formatting log messages (PatternLayout, JsonLayout, etc.)
A powerful plugin-based architecture for custom extensions
era_and_niche: The standard implementation for the modern Apache Log4j 2 framework. It is the official successor to the legacy `log4j:log4j` and a direct competitor to `ch.qos.logback:logback-classic`.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete**. It is an actively maintained, state-of-the-art logging implementation. Any project using the legacy Log4j 1.x should migrate to this library.
